issue: WBC was below the reference range at 8 of 10 timepoints, including on-treatment lows of 2.54 GI/L (Week 4) and 2.87 GI/L (Week 20), but no adverse event or medical history entry covers low WBC.
query_text: The central lab reports leukocytes (WBC) below the reference range (3.8–10.7 GI/L) at Screening 1 (3.22 GI/L, 2014-03-10) and at most on-treatment visits. The lowest values were 2.54 GI/L at Week 4 (2014-04-26) and 2.87 GI/L at Week 20 (2014-08-17). The only adverse event recorded is application site pruritus, and medical history does not include low WBC. Please review these results and confirm whether the investigator considers any of the on-treatment values clinically significant. If so, please record an adverse event. If the low WBC was a pre-existing condition, please consider whether it should be added to Medical History. If no change is needed, please confirm.
